decisions.story_title: MCP TypeScript SDK JSON-RPC Client ID Collision
decisions.reason: GitHub Security Advisory GHSA-jm63-cq47-j5jp documents JSON-RPC request id collision in MCP TypeScript SDK clients; two clients' ids collide by default on a shared server, enabling cross-client request confusion.
